वृद्धगार्ग्य

VṚDDHAGĀRGYA . An ancient hermit. Mention is made in mahābhārata, anuśāsana parva, Chapter 125, Stanza 77, that this hermit had conversed with the Manes about offerings made to them.

वृद्धकन्या

VṚDDHAKANYĀ . Daughter of the hermit named kuṇigarga. (For further details see under kuṇigarga).

वृद्धक्षत्र १

VṚDDHAKṢATRA I . The father of jayadratha, the king of sindhu. (See under jayadratha I).

वृद्धक्षत्र २

VṚDDHAKṢATRA II . A king born in the puru dynasty. He favoured the pāṇḍavas. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, droṇa parva, Chapter 200, Stanza 73, that in the bhārata battle, aśvatthāmā killed him.

वृद्धक्षत्र ३

VṚDDHAKṢATRA III . A king of the vṛṣṇi dynasty. This king took the side of the pāṇḍavas in the bhārata battle and was killed by bālhīka. (M.B. droṇa parva, Chapter 24,

वृद्धक्षेम

VṚDDHAKṢEMA . The king of the country trigarta. He was the father of suśarmā. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 185, Stanza 9).

वृद्धशर्मा

VṚDDHAŚARMĀ . One of the five sons, born to the king āyus by his wife Svarbhānū. The remaining four sons were nahuṣa, raji, gaya and anenas. (M.B. Ādi Parva, Chapter 75, Stanza 25).

वृद्धिका

VṚDDHIKĀ . A kind of goblin. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, Vana Parva, Chapter 231, Stanza 16, that once the semen of śiva fell scattered over the trees and that these goblins were born from that. Human flesh is the food of these goblins. It is said those who want children need only worship these Vṛddhikās.
